title: Analysis of Postoperative Analgesic Requirements Following Minimally Invasive Aortocoronary Bypass Surgery (MIC-TCRAT)
summary: In this specific project, medical records of patients who underwent bypass surgery using the TCRAT method are analyzed and compared with regard to cumulative opioid consumption in the first 72 hours postoperatively, along with information on the perioperative administration of opioids and peripheral analgesics. The aim is to determine whether and to what extent a reduction in opioid requirements occurs during the course of the inpatient stay. In addition, the data will be compared with respect to duration of intubation, length of stay in the intensive care unit, gender, and defined age groups.

interventions.name: A total of 900 digital ICCA-AR anesthesia records from July 2022 through May 2026, documenting MIC-TCRAT procedures, along with the corresponding digital charts from the surgical intensive care unit and recovery room, will be used for analysis.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-Age: 18 years or older
-Elective bypass surgery (TCRAT procedure)
-Urgent surgeries classified as N06, N12, N24, or N48
Exclusion criteria:
-Emergency surgeries, classification N01
-Patients with chronic pain
-Ongoing intensive care without the ability to collect data
-Incomplete documentation
